name: team_planning_set_placeholder_hire
description: Add a placeholder hire to a scenario of a Team Planning plan, or change one, with a label and the level and FTE they'd join at. Leave placeholder_id out to add one; the map then lists it as a person under that id, named by its label, and team_planning_set_assignment places it. A change replaces the label, level and FTE together, so send all three: one left out is cleared. An FTE is above 0 and at most 1. Refused unless the caller is one of the plan's editors.

scenario_id.description: The scenario, or the plan's id for the baseline.

placeholder_id.description: Omit to add a new placeholder hire.

label.description: What the plan calls them, such as "Payments engineer".
